Farmacias Similares
sells basic home health monitoring equipment like digital blood pressure monitors (baumanómetros) and blood glucose meters (such as the Gmate Wheel), but
they do not distribute advanced or continuous wearable medical devices
like smart ECG watches or continuous glucose monitor patches.
Facebook
Farmacias Similares
Available Home Medical Equipment
Blood Pressure Monitors:
Digital upper arm and wrist blood pressure cuffs.
Blood Glucose Meters:
Standard finger-prick glucometer kits, test strips, and lancets.
Basic Diagnostics:
Standard thermometers and pulse oximeters depending on local branch stock.
Mercado Libre

Farmacias Similares
does not sell continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or advanced sleep-tracking wearables
. Their inventory includes traditional finger-prick blood glucose meters like
Accu-Chek Active ($749.00)
and
On Call Plus ($449.00)
Health Tech Availability
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Not available at Farmacias Similares. Real-time biosensors (such as FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) require specialty medical suppliers or larger retail pharmacies.
Smartwatches & Wearables (ECG / Sleep Tracking):
Not stocked. Farmacias Similares focuses strictly on pharmaceuticals, basic diagnostic equipment (glucometers, blood pressure monitors, oximeters), and orthopedic supports.
Remote Patient Monitoring:
Farmacias Similares does not offer direct consumer remote patient monitoring hardware or subscription-based telemetry services, though their in-store medical consultation clinics can manually record vital signs during a visit.
